FILING_DESTINATION.detail: Applying DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001-A1's test first: no held source establishes the destination — the census records 'not recorded', NM.memo.json records the receiving office as 'Not determined', and the route contract names only 'the administrative centre'. The packet therefore states what the record holds (an administrative written request to the administrative center of the state DNA identification system, not a court filing, no Rule 1-077.1 form), says in terms that no held source identifies the center, unit, destination or format, deliberately supplies no address, and names the checkable authority: the New Mexico Department of Public Safety. That is the honest statement of a destination the repository does not hold, not a gesture.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: The page states 'No held source identifies the administrative center, receiving unit, destination, accepted request format, or fee. Confirm every one with the New Mexico Department of Public Safety before sending anything', and the instructions repeat 'fee if any; confirm it with the New Mexico Department of Public Safety'. That is the DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 third prong exactly: no-held-source stated plus a specific checkable authority named. A waiver route does not arise where no fee is established. No figure is invented.

SERVICE.detail: No held source states a service rule (the route contract and NM.memo.json carry none) and an administrative DNA-expungement request serves no opposing party. The packet does not carry a literal 'nobody is served' sentence; it states that this is an administrative written request to an agency and not a court filing, and names the New Mexico Department of Public Safety as the authority on the accepted request format and destination to confirm before sending. Under DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001 as extended to SERVICE, a named checkable authority standing in for a rule no held source establishes satisfies the obligation. Thinnest of the fifteen on this family; scored PASS on that standard.
